11. Again, the aforesaid directory nature of the obligation of Banks/Financial Institutions is further apparent from the style of employment of the words in sub-section (6) of section 12 of the Artharin Ain that if a Bank/Financial Institution without invoking section 12(3) of the Artharin Ain files the Artharin Suit, the Artharin Adalat should proceed with the said suit with a condition that at the time of passing the Decree the current value of the property, which is to be assessed on the basis of the valuation report to be submitted by the concerned sub-Register, shall be deducted from the decretal amount, either upon receipt of an application from the Judgment-debtor or suo motu by the Adalat. However, given that The law does not prohibit the Banks/Financial Institutions to go for 2nd and 3rd auction before filing Artharin Suit, in case of not finding a bidder with the expected value in the 1st and 2nd auction or if the scenario is that the Banks/Financial Institution could not proceed with the 1st and 2nd auction because of the factors which were beyond the control of the Bank/Financial Institution, the Banks/Financial Institutions are competent to go for 2nd and 3rd auction before filing the Artharin Suit. 

 13. In the case of Shakwat Hossain vs Artharin Adalat 19 BLC 74, in the midst of Artharin Suit being proceeded, when 1 (one) liened cargo vessel (named, MV Shawon-2 and 3 (three) separate pieces of mortgaged properties were put on auction, the debtor had challenged the auction, and though initially a Rule was issued along with passing an interim Order staying the auction, but ultimately the Rule was discharged and the interim Order was vacated. In the case of MA Hossain vs National Bank of Pakistan 7 ADC 595, our Hon'ble Apellate Division ruled that the provisions enshrined in the Proviso to section 6(5) of the Artharin Ain are applicable in execution of a Decree passed by the Artharin Adalat and, thus, not connected with power of sale of the mortgaged/hypothecated/pledged/ liened movable or immovable property under section 12 of the Artharin Ain.
